title: Gunnar's Ground
start: Speak to Dororan at the Gunnarsgrunn gate.

recommended.t: Skull sceptre (teleports you to the Barbarian Village)

kills.t: Haakon the Champion (level 40, optional); if he wants you to challenge him.

rewards.t: 200 Skill XP lamp (Skill must be level 5 or higher)
Ability to get further Crafting tasks from Dororan (requiring up to level 90 Crafting, temporary skill boosts allowed)

steps.t: Speak to Dororan near the eastern entrance to Barbarian Village. [Chat: Any › 1 Yes › Any › 2 Get to the point. › 1 There must be something you can do. › Accept]

You will receive a scroll containing a love poem, go to Edgeville and speak to Jeffery near the furnace. [Chat: 1 I'm here about a gold ring. › 1 I was hoping you would trade me a gold ring. › 1 This splendid love poem. › 1 Yes, he did. › 1 Just a plain, gold ring.]
Take the gold ring back to Dororan. [Chat: 1 What do you want me to engrave? › 2 That sounds simple enough.]
Click the 'engrave' option on the ring (tool belt chisel works), and show it to Dororan. [Chat: 1 It's come out perfectly. › 1 Of course. › 1 Very well.]
Speak to Gudrun (west of Dororan), but avoid telling her that Dororan is a dwarf. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 The ring isn't from me! › 1 A great poet. › 1 So, you want me to talk to your father?]

Talk to Gunthor, found in the longhall. [Chat: 1 I need to speak with you, chieftain. › 1 Your daughter seeks permission to court an outlander. › 1 You're barbarians › 1 Please wait a moment. › 1 I'm going!]
Return and talk to Gudrun. [Chat: 2 What should we do now?]
Speak to Dororan. [Chat: 1 No, she liked the ring. › 2 What are we going to do?]
Help him with his poem. [Chat: 1 I'm sure that's not true. › Any › 5 More words › 3 Stray. › Any › 5 More words › 1 Threat. › Any › 5 More words › 3 Swept to war.]

sub.t: The phrases are "stray", "threat", and "swept to war".

steps.t: Give the poem to Gudrun to read to her father. [Chat: Any › Any › Any › Any › Any]
Talk to Gudrun again to complete the quest. [Chat: Any]

get_inside.text: The skull sceptre offers unlimited direct teleports to the centre of Barbarian Village
Teleport to Falador lodestone and head east
Teleport to Varrock lodestone go through the city and exit on the west side and continue west
Teleport to Edgeville lodestone and head south
Barbarian Village has two main entrances; east and west, and a few smaller ones. The western entrance has a road leading to Falador, while the eastern one leads to Varrock.

Barbarians are scattered throughout the whole town - the male ones are level 30, while the female ones are level 28. Outside of the village are unicorns. In The Long Hall, Chieftain Gunthor, the current leader of the settlement, and Haakon the Champion, the mightiest barbarian in the settlement, can also be found.
